title: Content, self and auto-margin alignment
font: Ahem, font-size 10px, line-height 1 on the wrapper
units: Raw LayoutUnits of the zoomed layout: 1/(64*dpr) CSS px. Every box is logical [inline-start, block-start, inline-size, block-size] in the case writing mode and direction. c: the container border box within the wrapper border box (the wrapper is cb[0] x cb[1] logical px); items: the border boxes of the [data-i] elements in document order (labels) within the container border box. The wrapper carries writing-mode, the root carries direction. cols and rows are getComputedStyle gridTemplateColumns and gridTemplateRows. env[i] indexes distinct for envs[i].
